payload.reason: The evidence indicates that manual annotations were performed on a dataset of named entities, but it does not specify the use of a crowdsourcing platform for these annotations.

claims.text: A named entities dataset comprising 53453 tokens and 2566 sentences was manually annotated.
The manual annotation was based on categories and guidelines from BBN Technologies.
The dataset includes annotations for people, organizations, and locations in CoNLL03 format.
